headline: Board tabled rent increase for 72 William St, approved increases for 76 William St and 22 South Grafton St, and approved Findings of Fact for 963 Washington Ave.
summary: The Rent Board approved Findings of Fact and Conclusions of Law for 963 Washington Ave and for two West Company properties. It tabled a rent increase for 72 William St pending a city rent audit, approved rent increases for 76 William St and 22 South Grafton St, and found a rent increase application for 340 Eastern Promenade #213 complete pending certain items.
decisions: Approved the Findings of Fact & Conclusions of Law for 963 Washington Ave, all 4 units, with corrections, 6-0.
Approved both West Company Findings of Fact & Conclusions of Law, 6-0.
Tabled the rent increase application for 72 William St, all 3 units, until the City of Portland rent audit is resolved, 6-0.
Approved a rent increase for 76 William Street of $75.20 for unit 1, $103.20 for unit 2, and $151.20 for unit 3, 6-0.
Approved a rent increase for 22 Grafton St of $529.97 for unit 22 and, with Banked Rent backed out, $521.81 for unit 24, 6-0.
Approved that the application for 340 Eastern Promenade #213 be found complete once requested items are provided, and scheduled for public comment at a future meeting, 6-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Kristen Carreras moves to approve Findings of Fact & Conclusions of Law document for 963 Washington Ave, all 4 units with corrections. Seconded by Anne-Laure Razat. (6-0) The motion passes.
Anne-Laure Razat moves to approve both West Company Findings of Fact & Conclusions of Law. Seconded by Kristen Carreras. (6-0) The motion passes.
Anne-Laure Razat moves to table 72 William St, all 3 units, until the City of Portland rent audit is resolved. Seconded by Christopher "Buddy" Moore. (6-0). The motion passes.
Anne-Laure Razat moves to approve a rent increase 76 William Street, $75.20 for unit 1, $103.20 for unit 2, and $151.20 for unit 3. Seconded by Kristen Carreras. (6-0) The motion passes.

Anne-Laure Razat moves to approve rent increase for 22 Grafton St in the amounts of $529.97 for unit 22 and considering Banked Rent backed out, $521.81 for unit 24. Seconded by Matthew Lax. (6-0) The motion passes.

Matthew Lax moves that granted the requested items are provided (the invoice from the contractor's receipt, receipt for $1,000 items such as stove and tile, resolve the rent overcharged notice of violation, and AC unit moved to Capital Improvements) that the application would then be found complete and to be scheduled for public comment at a future meeting. Seconded by Jonas Burke. (6-0) The motion passes.
